stem.text: The volume of a vessel is $1.20 \times 10^{-3}\,\text{m}^{3}$. It contains pure argon at a pressure of $1.00 \times 10^{5}\,\text{Pa}$, and at a temperature of $25.0\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$. Under these conditions it can be assumed that argon behaves as an ideal gas.
Which mass of argon does it contain?
